abstract.para: The transactional wrapper has a configuration file that enables you to switch the funcionality off or modify its behavior after performing modifications to the file system.

topic.para: To change the default configuration copy the file to /etc
Modify the file as described in following sections.

section.title: Switching on/off the transactional wrapper
section.para: In the file you can switch off the transactional wrapper by setting the attribute ENABLE_TRANSACTIONAL_WRAPPER to 0:
Keep in mind that this disables calling &zypper; directly on the immutable system and to perform modifications to the file system, you must use the &tr-up; command.

section.title: Post-transaction bebhavior configuration
section.para: You can configure what the system should do after an operations finishes by changing the value of ACTION. Supported are the following values:

listitem.para: This options calls the transactional-update apply and the system switches to the new snapshot without needing to reboot
The system is rebooted immediately after an operation successfully completes
